decision.observed_event: You declare: "I rage and swing my greataxe at the dealer. I rolled 18 to hit, 11 slashing damage."

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: An attack the table resolved only as words.

improv_read.player_bid: Brakka rages and attacks the dealer, reporting a hit and damage.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl avoids personal risk and wants control; with the attack unresolved by the table, he tries to stop the fight with words.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit does not narrate a hit the table did not resolve and lets the room react to the threat.

public_brief.objective: Avoid risking himself in a fight he did not choose.
public_brief.tactic: Shout the dwarf down and offer him a way out before blood is drawn.
public_brief.visible_cue: Chairs go over; one player draws a knife; another stands too fast to follow.
public_brief.player_opening: He can stand down, leave south, or press the attack.
public_brief.reply_to: I rage and swing my greataxe at the dealer.
public_brief.kit_focus: Show the whole table moving at once and keep the swing's result unstated.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Every chair at the table goes over at once. The door-side player scrambles toward the wall, the fresco-side player has a knife in his fist, and the fourth player is suddenly on their feet without seeming to have stood.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Stop, dwarf! Steel at my table, after gold already paid? Put it down and walk on south, and we will forget your temper. Raise it again and the dead will settle this the old way. Which is it to be?
